description: Opens the case prepared with a confirmation_token, after the traveller confirmed it. Returns the case code, which is the key to the case afterwards, the case page and either a payment link (the case becomes active after payment) or, with an access code, an active case.

confirmation_token.description: confirmation_token from the prepare step, for example sc_3qJ8vT0kPzL1mW6xR2aYbQ. Valid for 15 minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Key that makes a retry safe: a repeated key returns the first result. Defaults to one key per confirmation_token.

name: sos_open_case
title: Open the SOS Flights case
